title: Get Involved
intro: We welcome students looking for research experience, and researchers or organizations interested in collaborating with us on healthy-ageing research.

internships.title: Research Internship / Research Assistant
internships.description: Help run study sessions, assist with EEG data collection, and support analysis of cognitive-games data.
internships.requirements: Open to Sunway University students (Psychology, Neuroscience, or related fields). No prior EEG experience required — training is provided.

collaborations.title: Partner With Us
collaborations.description: We're open to collaborating with other labs, faculty, and organizations working on healthy ageing, cognitive training, or social neuroscience.

contact.note: If you'd like to be considered for an internship or discuss a collaboration, feel free to email us with a short note about your interest.
contact.subject: Internship / Collaboration Inquiry - Connected Minds
